Wokingham Borough Council
Matthewsgreen Community Centre - Operator Opportunity (ProContract ref DN831703)
Document No 4 - Expression of Interest Questionnaire and Scoring Matrix (Updated 12.10.26)

Responses must be submitted via the ProContract messaging facility. Evaluation: 70% quality / 30% (see Document No 1).
No word or page limits apply. Please answer every question using the numbering below.

Organisation information (not scored): legal name, registered address, company number, main contact.

Q1 (10%) Describe your organisation's experience of operating community facilities or similar venues.

Q2 (10%) How will you engage local residents, community groups and partners in the running of the centre?

Q3 (10%)
Q3.I Describe your proposed operating model, including staffing and opening hours.
Q3.II Describe your mobilisation plan from lease signature to opening in Spring 2027.

Q4 (40%) Financial sustainability.
Q4.I Provide a sustainable business plan for the centre showing expected income and costs over the term of the lease,
including how you will meet the sinking fund contribution and your share of shared costs.

Q5 (20%) Vision 2035.
Q5.I How will the centre contribute to the Council's Communities Vision 2035?
Q5.II Describe a month in the life of the centre, showing the regular groups, one-off hires and events.
Q5.III Which KPIs will you report to the Council, and how often?

Q6 (10%) Describe your approach to equality, diversity and inclusion, and to safeguarding children and adults at risk.

Q7 (0%, not scored) Is there anything else you would like the Council to know?

Q8 (0%, not scored) Please confirm any conditions or assumptions attached to your expression of interest.
